newsDocuments.headline: Govt slashes petrol price by Re1, raises diesel's Rs2 per litre

segments.text: Pakistan government reduced the price of petrol by Re1 to Rs322 per litre, while increasing the diesel rate by Rs2 to Rs357 per litre, effective from Saturday, November 21, 2026.

The Oil and Gas Regulatory Authority (OGRA) announced the revised ex-depot prices in a notification issued on Friday, saying they were worked out under the petroleum products pricing mechanism approved by the federal government.
On Thursday, the government increased the price of petrol by Re1 to Rs323 per litre and kept the diesel rate unchanged at Rs355 per litre.
